Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi yield prisoner exchange

Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a prisoner exchange following talks in Abu Dhabi. The negotiations, which involved US mediation, concluded with the agreement on the exchange, though no broader breakthrough was reported. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the first day of talks as 'constructive'. Ahead of these discussions, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy regarding food corridors, on the eve of the resumption of Russia-Ukraine talks. Former US President Donald Trump suggested a breakthrough was possible, while Senator Marco Rubio expressed less optimism. US envoys are scheduled to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
